# lean-pkg index add

write &lt;index&gt;/&lt;name&gt;/entry.yaml from a clone at the pin.

## Usage

```text
lean-pkg index add [--from-registry] [--repo-dir REPO_DIR] [--url URL] [--tag TAG]
                   [--lower REL] [--comparator REL] [--license SPDX]
                   [--headline 'NAME :: FILE :: SUMMARY'] [--field-tag TAG]
                   [--formalization-yaml REL] [--consent-recorded] --by BY
                   [--allow-unpushed] [--notes NOTES] [--built-on-file FILE] [--replace]
                   [--index INDEX] [common flags] NAME
```

`[common flags]`: `--json`, `--commit`, `--push`, `--no-commit`, also accepted before the command name; see the [CLI overview](../cli.md).

## Arguments and flags

| Argument or flag | Description |
|---|---|
| `NAME` |   |
| `--from-registry` | start from the registry row (repo, receipts, license, palomar, doi, reservoir) |
| `--repo-dir REPO_DIR` | local clone to read from (never modified) |
| `--url URL` | public https URL (a GitHub ssh URL is converted) (old spelling --repo, kept working) |
| `--tag TAG` | release tag at the pin or an evidence-only descendant (or a docs-only one when lean-pkg-binding.yaml at the pin opts in) |
| `--lower REL` | lower-tier receipt, .lean-receipts/...json |
| `--comparator REL` | comparator receipt, .lean-receipts/...json |
| `--license SPDX` |   |
| `--headline 'NAME :: FILE :: SUMMARY'` |   |
| `--field-tag TAG` | free field tag (repeatable) |
| `--formalization-yaml REL` |   |
| `--consent-recorded` | every coauthor agreed to the listing (the pointer stays private) |
| `--by BY` | public handle of the person adding the entry. Required. |
| `--allow-unpushed` | do not verify that the pin and evidence are on the public repository (provisional entry) |
| `--notes NOTES` |   |
| `--built-on-file FILE` | YAML list of credits for third-party Lean code the package builds on (name, url, authors; optional license, pin, relation, note); \[] for none |
| `--replace` | replace an existing entry of this name (a re-pin); its built_on is carried over unless --built-on-file is given |
| `--index INDEX` | index root (default: $LEAN_PKG_INDEX, else index/ beside the registry when present, else ./index) |

## Details

| Form | What it does | Key flags |
|---|---|---|
| `index add NAME` | write `index/<name>/entry.yaml` from a clone at the pin: receipts validated with the `gate` and `comparator` validators and copied verbatim, trust computed, duplicates refused, event `index-added`; `--replace` re-pins an existing entry and carries its `built_on` credits over, `--built-on-file` sets them; a headline whose claim in `claims.yaml` at the pin is conditional (proposal 0003) gets the derived claim keys `status: conditional` and `open_hypotheses`, judged from the sealed log at the pin ([Conditional claims](../index-catalog.md#conditional-claims)) | `--by HANDLE` `--headline 'NAME :: FILE :: SUMMARY'` `[--from-registry]` `[--url URL]` `[--repo-dir PATH]` `[--lower REL]` `[--comparator REL]` `[--license SPDX]` `[--tag T]` `[--field-tag T]` `[--formalization-yaml REL]` `[--consent-recorded]` `[--notes]` `[--built-on-file FILE]` `[--replace]` `[--index PATH]` |

## Examples

Write index/my-proof/entry.yaml from the registry row (repository, receipts, license, Palomar, DOI, Reservoir), cloning the package at the pin, validating and copying its receipts and computing the trust level; refused when consent is not recorded, the entry already exists or the pin is not on a public branch.

```bash
lean-pkg index add my-proof --from-registry --by your-handle --headline 'MyProof.main_theorem :: MyProof/Main.lean :: One sentence saying what it proves.'
```

The same without a registry, with the repository, license and receipt paths passed as flags and every coauthor's consent asserted.

```bash
lean-pkg index add my-proof --url https://github.com/you/my-proof --license Apache-2.0 --lower .lean-receipts/0123456789ab-slurm-4242.json --comparator .lean-receipts/0123456789ab-comparator.json --consent-recorded --by your-handle --headline 'MyProof.main_theorem :: MyProof/Main.lean :: One sentence.'
```

Re-pin an existing entry at a new gated commit, replacing its receipt copies and carrying its built_on credits over unless --built-on-file is given.

```bash
lean-pkg index add my-proof --from-registry --replace --by your-handle --headline 'MyProof.main_theorem :: MyProof/Main.lean :: One sentence.'
```
